# jairoromo.ai — Jairo Romo

## Who is Jairo Romo?

Jairo Romo is a Mexican AI consultant, builder, and speaker specializing in practical Artificial Intelligence applications for real businesses. He has 3,000+ hours testing AI tools since 2022, a community of 5,000+ members, and has built 50+ AI-powered projects.

He teaches AI without jargon ("IA sin fricción") to entrepreneurs, lawyers, real estate agents, and business professionals in Spanish-speaking markets.

## Services

### 1:1 Consulting Sessions (jairoromo.ai/sessions)
Direct consultation with Jairo Romo:
- Enfoque Rápido: 20 min, $15 USD — for specific unblocking questions
- Sesión de Trabajo: 45 min, $79 USD — project diagnosis and next steps
- Consultoría Profunda: 90 min, $297 USD — full AI strategy for serious projects

### Claude de Cero a Cien Guide (jairoromo.ai/guia-claude)
Comprehensive Spanish-language guide to Claude AI for non-technical users. $127 USD.
Covers 4 levels: foundations, advanced prompting, professional workflows, automation.
Target audience: professionals who want to use Claude AI productively in Spanish.

### Courses (jairoromo.ai/courses)
Practical AI courses in Spanish for real-world application.

### Bóveda IA / AI Vault (jairoromo.ai/vault)
Community resource library with AI prompts, tools, templates, and real projects.
Categories: General, Claude, Gemini, Skills, Recursos, Abogados (lawyers), Inmobiliaria (real estate), Proyectos Comunidad.
Some resources are free; others are paid. Login required.
